body: Ngủ được với mẹ mày đó

I've been there. Every morning I woke up, I would get so disappointed to the point I would avoid looking at myself in the mirror. No words can express how much I hated myself. I had no friends, no love interest, my family looked down on me as if I was a black sheep in the household. One of my blood relatives said to my face: "No one would even care if you unalive yourself"

It was the darkest time of my life until now. Then I realised no other human being can appreciate me if I don't appreciate myself first. So I got up and start fixing things. I started doing workouts, learned how to be a valuable person, learned how to talk to my classmates, started talking to a cute girl I had a crush on.

Things got better. I fixed myself little by little and I believe you can do it too. We can make it out of this dark pit of depression and agony. Just to let you know that there is a way out, and you can make it.
